name: agent-scenario-loop
description: Scenario orchestration and evidence collection for agent-driven software development. Bring your own runner. Keep your scenarios. Keep your evidence.

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.release:check: pnpm test && pnpm release:readiness && pnpm package:smoke && pnpm consumer:rehearse
scripts.test: pnpm clean && pnpm typecheck && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/core/__tests__/*.test.js dist/runner/__tests__/*.test.js
scripts.example:profile:open-close: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/open-close-cycle.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/open-close-cycle.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id example-open-close
scripts.example:profile:scroll: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/scroll-settle.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/scroll-settle.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id example-scroll
scripts.example:profile:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/app-startup.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/app-startup.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id example-startup
scripts.example:profile:ios:live:open-close: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/open-close-cycle.json --simctl-capture --profile-session --profile-session-storage --launch --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id ios-live-open-close
scripts.example:profile:ios:live:scroll: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/scroll-settle.json --simctl-capture --profile-session --profile-session-storage --launch --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id ios-live-scroll
scripts.example:profile:ios:live:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/ios/app-startup.json --simctl-capture --profile-session --profile-session-storage --launch --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/ios --run-id ios-live-startup
scripts.example:profile:android:open-close: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/open-close-cycle.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/android-open-close-cycle.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-example-open-close
scripts.example:profile:android:scroll: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/scroll-settle.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/android-scroll-settle.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-example-scroll
scripts.example:profile:android:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/app-startup.json --events examples/mobile-app/event-logs/android-app-startup.log --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-example-startup
scripts.example:profile:android:live:open-close: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/open-close-cycle.json --adb-capture --profile-session --react-native-debug-host localhost:8097 --clear-logcat --launch --launch-wait-ms 1500 --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-live-open-close
scripts.example:profile:android:live:scroll: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/scroll-settle.json --adb-capture --profile-session --react-native-debug-host localhost:8097 --clear-logcat --launch --launch-wait-ms 1500 --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-live-scroll
scripts.example:profile:android:live:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-android.js --config examples/mobile-app/asl.config.json --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/android/app-startup.json --adb-capture --profile-session --react-native-debug-host localhost:8097 --clear-logcat --launch --launch-wait-ms 1500 --wait-ms 1000 --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android --run-id android-live-startup
scripts.example:android:preflight: pnpm build && node dist/runner/android-adb.js --package dev.agentscenarioloop.example --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/android-live-preflight --run-id android-live-preflight
scripts.example:agent-device:ios:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/agent-device.js --platform ios ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION:+--session $ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION} ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_UDID:+--udid $ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_UDID} --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/mobile/app-startup.json --app ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_APP_ID:-dev.agent-scenario-loop.example} --open --wait-ms ${ASL_EXAMPLE_AGENT_DEVICE_WAIT_MS:-1000} --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/agent-device-ios-startup --run-id agent-device-ios-startup
scripts.example:agent-device:android:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/agent-device.js --platform android ${ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION:+--session $ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION} ${ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_SERIAL:+--serial $ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_SERIAL} --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/mobile/app-startup.json --app ${ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_APP_ID:-dev.agentscenarioloop.example} --open --wait-ms ${ASL_EXAMPLE_AGENT_DEVICE_WAIT_MS:-1000} --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/agent-device-android-startup --run-id agent-device-android-startup
scripts.example:argent:ios:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/argent.js --platform ios --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/mobile/app-startup.json --app ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_APP_ID:-dev.agent-scenario-loop.example} --device ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_UDID:-booted} --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/argent-ios-startup --run-id argent-ios-startup
scripts.example:argent:android:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/argent.js --platform android --scenario examples/mobile-app/scenarios/mobile/app-startup.json --app ${ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_APP_ID:-dev.agentscenarioloop.example} --device ${ASL_EXAMPLE_ANDROID_SERIAL:-emulator-5554} --out artifacts/example-mobile-app/argent-android-startup --run-id argent-android-startup
scripts.example:app:ios:metro-port: if [ -n "${ASL_EXAMPLE_XCODE_DEVELOPER_DIR:-}" ]; then export DEVELOPER_DIR="$ASL_EXAMPLE_XCODE_DEVELOPER_DIR"; fi; xcrun simctl spawn ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_DEVICE:-booted} defaults write ${ASL_EXAMPLE_IOS_APP_ID:-dev.agent-scenario-loop.example} RCT_jsLocation ${ASL_EXAMPLE_METRO_HOST:-localhost}:${ASL_EXAMPLE_METRO_PORT:-8097}
scripts.profile:ios:startup: pnpm build && node dist/runner/profile-ios.js --config core/config-template.json --scenario examples/scenarios/ios/app-startup.json
